title: TUN3T'S MODPACK
description: A lightweight Fabric modpack focused on performance, shaders, and quality-of-life improvements. It enhances Minecraft with better FPS, beautiful graphics, and useful features while keeping the vanilla gameplay feel.
body:
📦 Modpack Description
This modpack for Minecraft (Fabric 1.21.11) is focused on high performance, enhanced visuals, and quality-of-life improvements, while staying close to the vanilla experience.

It combines powerful optimization mods, multiple shader options, and useful gameplay tweaks to deliver a smoother and more modern Minecraft experience.

⚙️ Optimization & Performance
Alternate Current – improves redstone performance and reduces lag in complex circuits.
FerriteCore – lowers RAM usage, helping the game run smoother.
Krypton – optimizes network performance, especially on servers.
Bobby – lets you see chunks beyond the server render distance.
Hero's Anchor Optimizer – improves performance of respawn anchors.
Marlow's Crystal Optimizer – optimizes end crystal behavior for better FPS.

🎨 Graphics & Shaders
Iris Shaders – modern shader loader for Fabric.
AstraLex Shaders – cinematic visuals with vibrant colors.
BSL Shaders – balanced visuals and performance.
Complementary Shaders (Unbound) – highly customizable and optimized.
MakeUp Ultra Fast Shaders – lightweight shaders for high FPS.
Photon Shaders – realistic lighting and atmosphere.

🧩 Libraries & Dependencies
Fabric API – essential core library for Fabric mods.
Cloth Config API – provides configuration menus for mods.

🛠️ Quality of Life
AppleSkin – shows detailed hunger and saturation info.
Gamma Utils (Fullbright) – increases brightness for better visibility.
Shulker Box Tooltip – preview shulker contents without opening them.
Mod Menu – easy access to installed mods and settings.
Modify Player Data – allows editing certain player-related values.

🎥 Multiplayer & Extras
ReplayMod – record and create cinematic replays.
Simple Voice Chat – in-game proximity voice chat.
Space Walker – adds unique movement or physics-related tweaks.

⭐ Summary
This modpack is perfect if you want better FPS, stunning visuals, and useful gameplay improvements while keeping the core Minecraft experience intact.
